description: dependence STRESS TEST (TASKS.md S56 author decision 3): comonotone re-pairing of the operation scenarios within each network and (year, day) block by rank of the daily net demand; complete within-network daily profiles, marginals, probabilities and EV inputs preserved; market arrays not permuted; not a calibrated or worst-case joint model
statistic: ND[s] = sum_{loads l not ADN} sum_t pd_l[s,t] * baseMVA * dt - sum_{generators g, gen_type in definitions.GEN_CURTAILLABLE_TYPES} sum_t pg_g[s,t] * baseMVA * dt, in MWh, dt = 24 h / num_instants; per network block (network, year, day); ADN loads = the TSO loads production zeroes after the checksum point (network.adn_load_exists / get_adn_load_idx for every DSO node); evaluation: float(np.sum(A[s])) * baseMVA * dt per array, accumulated in Python floats, loads by index then generators by index
tie_rule: perm = sorted(range(n), key=lambda s: (ND[s], s)): ascending ND, exact ties -> lower original index first; new index k takes original index perm[k]; new_A = old_A[perm, :] for every operation array of the block (market arrays never permuted)
array_sha_definition: sha256 over b"<f8" + repr(shape).encode("ascii") + np.ascontiguousarray(A, dtype="<f8").tobytes() (the array as float64, C order)
coherence: each load / generator quantity is sampled with its own seed (network._update_network_with_operational_data), so a scenario of a network is the index s: the tuple of row s of all of that network block's operation arrays; the permutation moves that tuple as a unit
post_read_expected_note: after read_planning_problem production replaces the TSO ADN loads' pd / qd by np.zeros (shared_resources_planning._add_adn_node_to_transmission_network); the sha256 they take then (zeros, identical in the base and the re-paired instance)
scenario_checksum_note: computed by the production read with the hook; recorded in the instance record
